checks.original_claim_and_assumptions: Independently read Definition 2.10 and Remark 3.4 in the released 2309.10229v2 main.tex (source lines 170-350, especially 324-345). The surrounding lattice is lin(P) intersect Z^n. The remark places integral alcoved polytopes in sum x_i=0 and claims intersection integrality and the two-factor Cayley triangulation. The facet-normal reading is explicitly checked against the remark's perpendicular-space argument.
checks.decisive_independent_check: For H in R^3 use u=x1-x2,v=x2-x3. Solving gives x=((2u+v)/3,(v-u)/3,-(u+2v)/3), and integrality requires u+2v=0 mod3. P=conv(0,(2,-1,-1),(1,1,-2)) and its integral translate by (1,-1,0) have root facet normals. Intersecting their three halfspaces gives u>=2,v>=0,u+v<=3, with vertex (u,v)=(2,0), hence (4/3,-2/3,-2/3) outside Z^3. The two primitive edge vectors in the integral x1,x2 coordinates have determinant3. Their height-zero/height-one Cayley simplex has no other lattice points because both segments are primitive and integral height can only be0 or1. Therefore it cannot have a unimodular lattice triangulation. These are exact algebraic checks performed by the current primary, not a replay of initial code.
checks.counterevidence_and_repair: Read actual retained HPPS arXiv1405.1687v3 text pp36,72,73. Its type-A convention uses the dual root lattice. Under that lattice the displayed fractional intersection vertex is integral and the segments cease to be primitive. This supports specifying the lattice; it does not refute HPPS Lemma4.15. The literal facet-direction ambiguity and diagonal perpendicular component remain disclosed.
checks.core_dependency_and_severity: Read the preceding complete main construction and its explicit reliance on Lemmas2.6/3.2/3.3. Theorem3.1 is already proved before the auxiliary Remark3.4 and does not use it. The proven defect therefore remains Minor due to its peripheral dependency, independently of the short repair.
